defs.def: to help sb remember sth, especially sth important that they must do 提醒；使想起

ex.s: Maybe that feeling comes from growing up in South Africa, where the phrase “there are children starving in Africa” was more of an uncomfortable reminder of fact than a prayer at dinner time.
ex.t: 也许那种感觉源于在南非长大，在那里，“非洲有儿童在挨饿”这句话与其说是一句餐前祈祷，不如说是对现实令人不安的提醒。

ex.s: Nevertheless, it serves as a reminder that there are many ways to address problems of sustainability, and that you can make an amazing meal out of almost anything.
ex.t: 不过，它提醒我们，解决可持续性问题的办法有很多，而且你几乎可以用任何东西做出美味的饭菜。

ex.s: That dream reminded me that those fears and desires could encourage me to take risks and make experiments.
ex.t: 那个梦提醒我，那些恐惧和欲望可以鼓励我去冒险和尝试。

ex.s: As I served the role of vital communication link, I was reminded of my desperate struggle to converse before I learned English.
ex.t: 当我担任重要的沟通桥梁角色时，我想起了自己在学会英语之前拼命试图交流的痛苦挣扎。

ex.s: That is a reminder of how little we know of our planet, and that we are not the only creatures with hidden complexities.
ex.t: 那提醒我们对自己星球的了解多么少，也提醒我们并非只有我们才拥有隐藏的复杂性。

ex.s: It is enough to put the page number and one or two words as a reminder .
ex.t: 记下页码和一两个词作为提醒就足够了。

ex.s: to remind people of a historical period
ex.t: 以唤起人们对一个历史时期的记忆

ex.s: It reminds her that children don’t enter life  47  to take risks or unwilling to  48  again when they fall down.
ex.t: 这提醒她，孩子进入生活时并不____47____去冒险，也不是在跌倒后不愿再次____48____。

ex.s: To remind students to protect public property.
ex.t: 提醒学生保护公共财产。

ex.s: her effort to remind mom to obey traffic rules
ex.t: C．她努力提醒妈妈遵守交通规则。

ex.s: However, her dad reminded her that sugary treats were bad for her teeth.
ex.t: 到她13岁时，她的公司已经价值数百万美元，因为她发明了一种超级甜美的零食，它能保护孩子的牙齿而不是损害牙齿。
跳舞让我意识到自己还活着。

ex.s: He was just saying: “I’m king of this forest, and here is your reminder!” Once his message was delivered, he allowed me    70    (stay) and watch.
ex.t: 它只是在说："我是这片森林之王，这是提醒你！"一旦传达完信息，它允许我____70____（stay）留下观察。

ex.s: Does a character remind you of friend?
ex.t: 有没有哪个角色让你想起朋友？

ex.s: Here are some of our favourites, to remind us that some of the English we learn in the classroom is rather different from the English in the outside world!
ex.t: 以下是我们最喜欢的几个例子，它们提醒我们，我们在课堂上学的一些英语和外面世界里的英语相当不一样！

ex.s: From time to time I look at the photo as a reminder to show respect to all animals.
ex.t: 我时不时地看着这张照片，提醒大家要尊重所有的动物。

ex.s: More and more people feel that by using natural dyes, we can remind ourselves of nature's beauty and protect the natural world.
ex.t: 越来越多的人感到，通过使用天然染料，我们可以提醒自己大自然的美，并保护自然世界。

ex.s: We could also say Now and then I look at the photo to remind myself that we need to respect all animals, because we are the visitors to their world.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：我不时看看这张照片，提醒自己我们需要尊重所有动物，因为我们是它们世界里的访客。

ex.s: It reminded me of blue cheese, a similarly strong smelling type o food you either love or hate.
ex.t: 它让我想起蓝纹奶酪，一种气味同样浓烈、让人爱憎分明的食物。
